name: ECOSYS
recent: EcoSys 于 2026 年 10 月 14 日在 ACE Market 上市，IPO 发行 145,696,000 股新股，每股 RM0.27。上市后股价大幅上涨，公司计划在年底前将洁净室产能扩大近一倍。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收环比增长 37.4%，净利环比增长 39.3%。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 10 月 14 日在 Bursa Malaysia 的 ACE Market 上市，IPO 发行 145,696,000 股新股，发行价每股 RM0.27。
上市后股价大幅上涨，媒体报道股价一度上涨约 196%。
公司计划在年底前将洁净室产能扩大近一倍，以应对需求增长。
risks: 非独立非执行主席 Gan Teck Hooi 于 2026 年 10 月 14 日以每股 RM0.820 出售 100,000 股。
董事及高级管理层在 IPO 中认购股份，包括主席、独立董事、首席财务官及董事经理。
董事经理 Chan Chee Wei 的持股因上市扩大股本而被稀释 52.15%。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 30,989,000，环比增长 37.4%；净利为 MYR 3,121,000，环比增长 39.3%；净利率为 10.1%，上一季度为 9.9%。

recent_en: EcoSys listed on the ACE Market on 14 October 2026, issuing 145,696,000 new shares at RM0.27 per share. The share price rose sharply after listing, and the company plans to nearly double its cleanroom capacity by year-end. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue grew 37.4% QoQ and net profit grew 39.3% QoQ.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia on 14 October 2026, with an IPO of 145,696,000 new shares at RM0.27 per share.
The share price rose sharply after listing, with media reporting a gain of about 196% at one point.
The company plans to nearly double its cleanroom capacity by year-end to meet growing demand.
risks_en: Non-Independent Non-Executive Chairperson Gan Teck Hooi disposed of 100,000 shares at RM0.820 per share on 14 October 2026.
Directors and senior management subscribed for shares under the IPO, including the Chairperson, Independent Directors, CFO and Managing Director.
Managing Director Chan Chee Wei's shareholding was diluted by 52.15% due to the enlarged share capital upon listing.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 30,989,000, up 37.4% QoQ; net profit was MYR 3,121,000, up 39.3% QoQ; net margin was 10.1% versus 9.9% in the previous quarter.
